design_rationale: The design balances trustworthiness with warmth through a color palette anchored in deep, stable blues paired with a golden accent that evokes the reliability of a dependable neighbor. Typography employs a traditional serif for headings to convey expertise and stability, while a clean sans-serif body font maintains accessibility and modern professionalism. Generous spacing, soft shadows, and rounded corners create an approachable atmosphere that feels genuine rather than corporate.

sections.name: hero
sections.layout: Full-width hero with asymmetrical split: left side contains text content (60% width), right side contains image (40% width). On mobile, stacked vertically.
sections.background: Warm off-white gradient from #F8F7F5 (left) to #F2EDE5 (right), with a subtle diagonal accent stripe in primary color (#1B4965) on far right edge (40px wide, 15deg rotation)
sections.image_style: Professional HVAC technician in blue uniform smiling at homeowner on residential front porch, natural daylight, authentic and warm interaction
sections.overlay: None on image; light gradient overlay on text side: rgba(24, 24, 24, 0.03) to rgba(248, 247, 245, 0)
sections.cta_style: Primary button with golden accent background, white text, 1rem padding, 8px border radius, strong subtle shadow

sections.name: services
sections.layout: 3-column grid on desktop (each card takes equal width with 2rem gap), 2-column on tablet, 1-column on mobile. Full container width.

card_style.hover_effect: Translate up 6px, shadow increases to 0 12px 28px rgba(27, 73, 101, 0.15), accent border-top color shifts from transparent to #E8A866 (4px border-top added on hover)
card_style.icon_style: SVG icons 56x56px in accent color (#E8A866), contained in circular background 80x80px in rgba(232, 168, 102, 0.12), top-aligned above h4 heading

sections.name: about/trust
sections.layout: Two-column layout: left column contains image (50%), right column contains text content with nested stat blocks (50%). Vertically aligned center. Image on left on desktop, stacked above on mobile.
elements: Warm photograph of owner/family in workshop or office setting
Body paragraph (2-3 sentences) about company history and values
Three stat blocks in a vertical stack: number (h3 weight 700), label text (small weight 500), each with subtle dividing line
Stat block background: rgba(232, 168, 102, 0.08) with 2px left border in accent color
Optional: 'Proud Member of [Trade Association]' text with small badge/logo

sections.name: testimonials
sections.layout: Carousel or grid showing 3 visible testimonials on desktop (with visible next/prev indicators), auto-scrolls or pagination-controlled. 2 visible on tablet, 1 on mobile. Cards span equally in a row.

card_style.quote_style: Serif italic headlined with large quotation mark in accent color (#E8A866, 2.5rem, opacity 0.3, positioned absolutely top-left), customer name in h4, company/title in small gray text below, 5-star rating SVG in accent color above quote

sections.name: cta_banner
sections.layout: Full-width horizontal banner with centered text and prominent CTA button. Flexbox centered alignment.
sections.background: Linear gradient from primary (#1B4965) at 0% to primary_dark (#0F2F45) at 100%, angle 135deg. Subtle texture overlay: repeating diagonal lines at 45deg, 2px spacing, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)
sections.button_style: Large secondary style button: 18px golden accent border (3px), white text, large padding (1rem 2.5rem), 8px radius, uppercase font-weight 700, hover state adds shadow 0 8px 20px rgba(232, 168, 102, 0.3)

sections.name: footer
sections.layout: 4-column grid on desktop (equal width), 2-column on tablet, 1-column on mobile. Columns: Services, Company, Contact, Newsletter signup. Bottom section with copyright text and social icons.
sections.text_color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) for body, white for headings
sections.link_color: #E8A866 (accent) with opacity 0.8 default, opacity 1 on hover

button_primary.hover: background darkens to #D9935A, shadow expands to 0 6px 18px rgba(232, 168, 102, 0.4), cursor pointer

button_secondary.hover: background becomes rgba(232, 168, 102, 0.08), border-color stays same

input.focus_ring: outline none, box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(232, 168, 102, 0.2), border-color changes to #E8A866

mobile_adjustments: Hero section stacks vertically; text full-width (100%), image full-width below; accent stripe removed
H1 font-size reduces to 2.25rem, H2 to 1.75rem
Services grid switches to 1 column; card padding reduces to 1.5rem
About section: image and text stack vertically (image full width, text full width below)
Testimonials: show 1 card at a time with pagination dots instead of carousel arrows
CTA banner height reduces to 220px, button text font-size reduces slightly to 1rem
Footer switches to single column; increased padding (1.5rem instead of 2rem); newsletter input becomes full-width block
Section padding-x reduces to 1rem on mobile to maximize content width
All shadows reduce opacity by 20% on mobile for lighter appearance
Footer columns stack: Services, Company, Contact, Newsletter in order from top
